facts.text: The image is a vertical multi-panel character reference sheet with one large rainy rooftop shot at the top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four detail close-ups at the bottom.
The top HERO panel shows a lone person standing on a wet rooftop or balcony at night in rain, with city lights and lit windows behind them.
The person has short dark hair shaved at the sides with a small topknot at the crown, and a diagonal scar is visible above one eyebrow in the face close-up.
The person wears a black tactical jacket with a high buckled collar and shoulder straps, a black T-shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The middle row contains three studio views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, showing the same dark-clad person against a near-black background.
The bottom row contains four close-ups labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The FACE close-up shows a neutral, direct gaze and a diagonal scar above one eyebrow.
The JACKET COLLAR close-up shows dark fabric with a strap and metal buckle.
The HANDS close-up shows two weathered hands with visible veins and knuckles.
The BOOTS close-up shows dark leather lace-up combat boots with heavy soles and laces.
The hero panel uses a cool blue-gray night palette with warm amber points from distant lights and reflections on the wet ground.
The studio panels use low-key lighting and a neutral dark backdrop, isolating the figure and clothing details.
Legible labels in the sheet read HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
